title: Full-Stack PHP Developer
description:
We're looking for a Full-Stack PHP Developer to join a platform in the B2B sales and outbound space. You'll work across backend (Laravel, PostgreSQL) and frontend (Nuxt 3/Vue), continue building out the product, and contribute to new AI-powered functionality. 

 

Responsibilities: 

  • Develop and maintain backend functionality on Laravel 12 and PostgreSQL 
  • Build and extend frontend features with Nuxt 3/Vue 
  • Design and implement new features powered by the Claude API 
  • Work within an existing codebase: understand current architecture, improve it, and keep it consistent 
  • Collaborate with the team on scope, priorities, and technical decisions 

 

Requirements: 

  • 3+ years of commercial experience in full-stack development 
  • Strong hands-on experience with PHP and Laravel 
  • Solid experience with Vue.js and Nuxt 3 
  • Experience with PostgreSQL: schema design, queries, performance 
  • Comfortable joining and working in an existing production codebase 
  • Upper-Intermediate level of English or higher 

 

Nice to Have: 

  • Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI, or similar) 
  • Experience building AI-powered features in production: prompting, structured outputs, tool use 

 

Recruitment Process: 

  1. HR Interview 
  2. Tech & Final Interviews 
  3. Job Offer 

 

We Offer: 

  • Innovation Culture: Work in a team that actively experiments with AI and modern development approaches    
  • Flexible Work: Remote work or a modern office in Kyiv   
  • Generous Time Off: 20 paid vacation days + 15 sick leave days annually   
  • Professional Growth: Compensation for courses, certifications, and learning resources   
  • Cutting-Edge Tools: Access to premium AI tools (Cursor Pro, Сlaude Code, Codex, etc.)
